predecessors.name: Duchy of Berg
predecessors.text: 'The territory emerged under the name of Berg-Altena in 1160'; 'His father used the older title Altena or Berg-Altena'

successors.name: Duchy of Cleves
successors.text: 'In 1391, Adolph III also inherited the Mark from his elder brother Engelbert III'; 'united both counties as Cleves-Mark in 1394'

wars.name: Battle of Worringen
wars.outcome: 'Count Eberhard II fought on the side of Duke John I of Brabant'; afterward 'the county gained supremacy in southern Westphalia'.

certainty.note: The page gives an area (about 3,000 km2) and no boundary; the northern gains of the 14th century are undated.
